source: In Weevils, chat is being integrated into the existing preview reader, so you can message while keeping the page in view. Keeping your browsing position intact as you use the chat is part of that work.

source: Your recent feed contains many consecutive TLO journey updates, while 31 of your last 34 sessions were on weevils. I suggest asking weevboss to prepare a project rotation for For you, so repeated milestones leave room for your other work.
text: TLO updates are crowding For you. Preview a feed order that gives other projects room.

source: Weevils can now be installed with Codex alone, and the release candidate passed 1,326 tests plus 129 installation checks. source: You want For you to keep experimenting and improve around what you enjoy, but your preferences already rule out extra header controls. Ask weevboss to prepare a simple feedback habit: tell it which card worked and why, then have it carry that preference into the next formats.
text: Tell weevboss which card worked for you and why. Use that feedback when preparing the next layouts.

source: You want For you cards coloured by project while keeping the header simple. Ask weevboss to prepare a consistent project palette across themes, then preview it on a TLO split-panel card and a horizontal weevils card.
text: Preview project colours on a TLO split-panel card and a horizontal weevils card, across themes.

source: Did you know Playwright can test a fresh browser session with no saved login? Ask your agents to check that your friends can open the release and complete its first steps without your private settings.
text: Use Playwright to check the first steps in a fresh browser session, without your saved login or private settings.
